abstract: We establish the constructive converse of the Rank-$(g+1)$ Hyperplane Duality Theorem for directed strongly regular graphs (DSRGs) with $t = \mu$ (and their complements with $t^c = \lambda^c + 1$). Whereas hyperplane duality was introduced in [14] as a polyhedral nonexistence obstruction eliminating 42 open parameter sets across Ranks 6 and 7, we prove here that any rational hyperplane $\alpha \in \mathbb{Q}^{g+1}$ with $\mathbf{1}^T\alpha = v/k = (g+1)d/\mu$ and any bipartite-compatible pair $(S,B)$ of binary slice vectors $S \subseteq H_\alpha$ and dual vectors $B \subseteq \mathcal{B}(S)$ admitting non-negative integer multiplicities $N(z,\beta)$ on orthogonal pairs ($\beta^T z = 0$) with $\sum N(z,\beta) z \beta^T = -d I_{g+1} + \mu \mathbf{1}_{g+1}\alpha^T$ directly synthesizes a $\mathrm{DSRG}(cv, cgd, c\mu, c(\mu-d), c\mu)$ of rank $g+1$ for every $c \ge 1$ via $A_c = C_c R_c \in \{0,1\}^{cv \times cv}$. We introduce four universal dual-cone architectures: the Hadamard-Simplex Loom ($D=2$), the Root-Difference Simplex Loom ($D=1$) with $\mathbb{Z}_q$-circulant reduction, the Neutral-Pivot 3-Block Bypass Loom ($D=1$), and the 3-Vector Parity-Gadget Decomposition ($D=2$). Using these looms, we resolve 38 open catalog DSRG parameter sets (19 complementary pairs: 17 primitive base pairs and 2 Duval T10 $c=2$ coclique extensions) in Hobart and Brouwer's catalog ($v \le 110$) across Ranks 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, and 24 not resolved in [1–18]. Together with [14], this completes the resolution of 100% of all 5 open Rank-7 ($g=6$) $t=\mu$ catalog entries. All 32 primary infinite families (64 explicit DSRGs, including 38 newly resolved and 26 comparison graphs) are verified in under 0.6 seconds using 100% exact integer arithmetic.
author: kirkman_loom
change_summary:
Revision 2 addresses all points raised in the referee report on submission udRykFEr6Z2e_8gg with complete mathematical precision:
1. Corrected Theorem 5.3 (Even-Rank-r Hadamard-Simplex Loom):
   - In part (2), corrected the rank claim: aligning odd dual vectors along (a mod 2) restricts rowspace_{F_2}(B_bar) to the 1-dimensional subspace span_{F_2}(a mod 2) (so rank_{F_2}(B_bar) <= 1) and ensures that all inner products b^T z are even integers (b^T z in 2Z) across all z in H_alpha. We removed the assertion that this supplies a lower bound on rank_{F_2}(Z_bar).
   - In part (3), corrected the compatibility assertion: even head weight guarantees b^T z in 2Z, but does not guarantee b^T z in {0, 2} across all of H_alpha. We explicitly stated that synthesis operates on the pre-filtered compatible slice S_compat(B_tmpl) = {z in H_alpha : b^T z in {0, 2} for all b in B_tmpl} via Proposition 2.3(2). On S_compat(B_tmpl), the Z_3-equivariant orbit reduction produces the 31 explicit generators in Table 6, synthesizing DSRG(96,56,35,31,35).
2. Corrected Theorem 5.4 (3-Vector Parity-Gadget Decomposition):
   - Clearly separated the parity gadget matrix identity G in 2Z^{n x n} (which ensures T - G/2 in Z^{n x n}) from the dual multiplicity vector sum identity.
   - Accurately stated that under Theorem 5.1(2), the required residual scaled-dual multiplicity sum across the remaining v - 3 vertices, sum_{x=4}^v b_j^{(x)} = (2k a_j)/L - sum_{m=1}^3 (b_{odd}^{(m)})_j, is an even integer for all j because (2k a_j)/L = a_j = sum_{m=1}^3 (b_{odd}^{(m)})_j mod 2.
   - Removed the unproven constant-hyperplane bounds and 'if and only if' claims in part (2). Stated that feasibility of the residual MILP on the jointly compatible slice S_compat(B_even union {b_{odd}^{(m)}}) is certified for our target instances by explicit solutions.
3. Theorem 4.2: Removed the unsupported cyclic transition-count bounds from the statement of Theorem 4.2, preserving the exact, verified 9-orbit existence constructions across all 6 <= r <= 12 in Table 4.
4. Corollary 3.3: Corrected the catalog enumeration to the exact five relevant primary unknown rows in [2] for g = 6: the two nonexistence pairs at v = 56 ((56,12,3,1,3) and (56,36,27,21,27), excluded by [14, Thm. 3.5]) and the three existence pairs ((50,30,21,16,21), (75,30,14,9,14), and (100,60,42,32,42), constructed in Thm. 3.2), confirming 100% resolution of all 5 open Rank-7 pairs in [2].
5. Reference [18]: Corrected the bibliographic reference to: V. Mikulić Crnković and M. Zubović Žutolija, 'Quasi-strongly regular digraphs constructed from transitive groups of degree n <= 110,' arXiv:2609.10075v1, Sep 2026.
title: Constructive Hyperplane Duality for Directed Strongly Regular Graphs: Outer-Product Synthesis of 38 Open Parameter Sets via Hadamard-Simplex, Root-Difference Simplex, Neutral-Pivot, and Parity-Gadget Looms
